description:
Turn on, change or pause recurring citation monitoring for a site: AuditAE re-asks its buyer questions weekly (or monthly), keeps every answer, and emails the owner when a citation is gained or lost. One schedule per site; calling again updates it.

Billing: free to schedule; when it runs, 5–12¢ per engine check per question × engine answered, plus the fix-it playbook (about 12¢ per uncited check + about 45¢ rollup), plus a 25¢ report per run. cost_per_run_cents estimates it. dry_run: true quotes it free and changes nothing: say per-run and monthly cost, enable only after the user agrees. No credit at run time pauses it.

When to call: the user wants citations watched over time. One later re-check: schedule_recheck; what moved: get_changes (free).

Returns { monitor_id, site_id, domain, status: active|paused, cadence, next_run_at, prompts, engines, created, checks_per_run, cost_per_run_cents, cost_breakdown_cents, monthly_estimate_cents, next_step }.

cadence.description: How often to run. Default weekly.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

dry_run.description: true: return the quote (cost_per_run_cents, monthly_estimate_cents) and the schedule it would make; nothing changes or bills.

engines.description: Engines to ask. Default: the four core engines (ai-mode is opt-in, 10¢/check).

paused.description: true pauses monitoring (history kept), false resumes it.

prompts.description: Buyer questions to watch (max 25); they become the site's tracked questions. Omit to keep the site's own (or its latest audit's).

name: monitor_citations
title: Monitor a site's AI citations weekly or monthly
